entries.notes: Initial v4 range inherits the existing v3.9.2-line adapter contract, not a new live-panel run of the v4 release binary. The compiled 3.4.2 floor remains necessary for POST /panel/api/server/scanRealityTargets; the 3.7.0 ceiling comes from the live PSP-adapter verification recorded in v3.json (shared-client, inbound, status and REALITY paths). Current source and request-shape tests retain that surface, including explicit panel-renewal-off fields and PSP-owned HWID limits. Register 3X-UI 3.7.0 with an admin-scoped API token; monitor/node-sync scopes do not cover PSP's API surface. Adopted hand-made finalmask inbounds may require re-saving after the upstream 3.6.0 migration. Panel/core upgrade endpoints were checked for route presence in the recorded verification, not executed. This manifest does not certify PN remote upgrades, traffic/quota end-to-end behaviour, or rollback of a migrated PSP database. Add a narrower entry first if a later v4 adapter changes its required contract.

sui_entries.notes: S-UI 1.6.1 live adapter verification (2026-09-12) used the current PSP checkout against a fresh scratch panel built from tag 48a67a3, its pinned frontend, Go 1.26.7 and upstream test profile on darwin/arm64 (Naive outbound omitted). TestLive_SUISurface passed; temporary overlay checks also confirmed credential/enable/expiry/quota read-back, bulk create/attach/delete, server-owned traffic-counter preservation and maintenance stop/running status parsing. /apiv2 Token authentication, save envelopes and client/inbound JSON fields remain compatible across 1.6.0..1.6.1; sing-box remains 1.14.0. This is current-adapter verification, not a v4 release-binary run, existing-database upgrade test or proxy traffic/quota end-to-end certification. No verified minimum S-UI version is published. New TLS spoofing and OpenVPN/OpenConnect endpoint TLS are outside PSP feature coverage; per-inbound enable, IP/device caps and optional panel/core update, certificate and REALITY-scan capabilities remain unsupported. The historical 1.6.0 verification remains recorded in v3.json.

3.5.0.text: 升级 3X-UI 到 3.5.0 会同时升级内置 Xray-core 到 v26.7.11 并重启内核。上游拒绝同时启用 Final Mask 与 REALITY 的 inbound；MTProto 会迁移到多客户端模型，且 tg:// 链接不再携带 remark。另有流量计数修复与 inbound 端口旧 UNIQUE 约束移除。PSP 适配器兼容依据沿用 v3 清单的既有验证记录，不代表对 V4 发布二进制另做实机验证。

3.6.0.text: 升级 3X-UI 到 3.6.0 会同时升级内置 Xray-core 到 v26.7.28 并重启内核。手工配置过 finalmask 的 inbound 请注意：XMC 格式从 usernames 改为 profiles，旧掩码需手工更新；REALITY inbound 的 finalmask.tcp 会被开机迁移删除。若该 inbound 已被 PSP 接管，旧配置快照可能持续 pending，请在 PSP 节点编辑器中重新保存；订阅只读 finalmask.udp，不受这处删除影响。PSP 自己创建的节点不受上述手工配置迁移影响。兼容依据是 v3 清单记录的既有适配器验证，而非 V4 发布二进制新实测。

3.7.0.text: 3X-UI 3.7.0 内置 Xray-core 仍锁定 3.6.0 的 commit（5ca6f4b / v26.7.28）。给 PSP 新建 API token 时必须使用 admin scope；monitor 和 node-sync scope 覆盖不了 PSP 的接口。旧 token 的空 scope 会由上游迁移补为 admin。不要在 3X-UI 中为 PSP 管理的客户端设置面板侧自动续期或流量重置周期：PSP 会主动关闭 resetDay/resetMax/trafficReset/trafficResetDay，避免面板改写 PSP 的到期与流量账本。HWID 上限 limitHwid 由 PSP 管理，应在 PSP 用户编辑界面设置，PSP 会覆盖面板侧改动；非 PSP 管理的客户端不受影响。兼容上限沿用 v3 清单记录的既有 3.7.0 适配器实机验证，并非 V4 发布二进制新实测。

1.6.0.text: S-UI 1.6.0 会升级内置 sing-box 到 1.14 并重启内核，还会迁移全局 DNS、缓存、rule-set 和 TLS ACME 配置。legacy DNS address 过滤器及 DNS 规则 strategy 动作不会自动迁移，需要按上游提示手工转换。客户端名称从此不能为空、不能与其他客户端重名，保存时会去除首尾空格；PSP 的唯一客户端 email 满足这项要求。/apiv2、Token 认证和客户端/inbound 模型的兼容依据来自 v3 清单记录的既有 1.6.0 适配器实机验证，并非 V4 发布二进制新实测。

1.6.1.text: S-UI 1.6.1 内置 sing-box 仍为 1.14.0。PSP 已在临时 1.6.1 面板上完成现有适配器接口验证，Token 认证及客户端、入站读写兼容，无需修改适配器。新增维护模式会主动停止内核并保持停止，需在 S-UI 中退出维护模式才能恢复服务；PSP 当前显示内核停止状态。浏览器登录失败 10 次会锁定来源地址 10 分钟，公开地址的反向代理不再受信任，可能影响登录日志和限流的来源地址识别；这些调整不影响 PSP 的 Token 请求。新增 TLS spoofing 与 OpenVPN/OpenConnect endpoint TLS 不属于 PSP 已支持的功能，本次验证也不代表完整代理流量、配额执法或已有数据库升级验证。
